Title: Cause and Effect wants to pick YOUR brain!

Messages.Author: Forhead
Messages.Body:
Greetings everyone!

Cause and Effect needs your input. We would love to get your ideas on the following three areas. If you only have something to say one or two of these areas we would want to hear that as well. Answers can be sent to  as well.

1) Guests. What guest would you like to see in the future and what deck and/or subject would you like us to discuss with that particular player.

2) Deck Clinc. Do you got a deck that you would like us to take a look at and propose an improvement to. Send us a deck list and description of the deck and the problems that you've encountered while playing it. Also if there are any parts that you DON'T want to get changed, let us now.

3) Ideas and Themes. Any practicular theme or deck that you would want to see in a show.

Thank you for taking the time and energy into helping us.

Isak Esbjörnsson Bjärmark

Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
Beside discussion of specific deck or card discussion I would like to hear more about "generic" topics, e.g.

* table/threat assessment. You had this and that decks at the table and player X won, because he backousted, or let his prey oust, ...
* final table seating: if your top seeded or second seeded, how did you choose your position at an exemplary table.
* crypt selection for your deck. How do approach the selection. Clan first? Disipline first? Special ability and then build around it. Each of you could explain how he came to a particular crypt selection for a given deck.

And I think I could name a few topics more, the above is just the ones I came up with at this moment.
